{{Quote|I'm on my way.|Trooper|<ref name="Blaster Game" />}}
'''Trooper''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, Trooper aided in the defense of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] stronghold that housed rare [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifacts]] which the Separatists attempted to steal.

==Biography==
===Reporting for duty===
{{Quote|Word has come in from the Jedi Council that enemy forces have discovered the Republic's stockpile of rare Jedi artifacts. If these fell into the hands of the Separatists, it could swing the war in their favor. Your mission is to give up your current post and make your way to the Republic's stronghold and defend the Jedi artifacts.|Obi-Wan Kenobi briefing Trooper|<ref name="Blaster Game" />}}
[[File:CTBG-TrooperFacesDroids.png|thumb|left|250px|Trooper faces down battle droids on the way to the extraction point.]]
The soldier who would be known as Trooper was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Blaster Game" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="db" /> [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="Blaster Game" /> of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Trooper was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to serve as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and fight in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="db" />

At some point during the war, Trooper received a message from [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] regarding rare [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifacts]]. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] discovered the Separatist's knowledge of the Republic's stockpile of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] artifacts. Due to the risk of the war swaying in the Separatist's favor if they acquired the artifacts, Trooper gave up their current post and traveled to the stronghold to defend the artifacts.<ref name="Blaster Game" />

Arriving at the outskirts of a command center, Trooper immediately began fighting off the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2-Series]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] as the clone made their way to the command center. At the command center, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] informed Trooper that the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] discovered a weakness in the center's shielding and infiltrated part of the base. While they had it under control, Rex warned Trooper that they may encounter some battle droids on the way to the extraction point. As Trooper traversed the corridors of the base, they encountered the battle droids Rex warned them about.<ref name="Blaster Game" />

===Extraction===
{{Quote|Nice work Trooper. You made it to the extraction point in record time. However, your transport was lost en route to the Command Center. We're going to need you to hold your position until we can get you out of there.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Blaster Game" />}}
[[File:CTBG-HailfireDroid.png|thumb|right|250px|Aboard a BARC speeder, Trooper takes on a Hailfire droid.]]
At the extraction point, Trooper was notified by Obi-Wan Kenobi that the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was lost en route to the command center and that they would have to hold the position until the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT gunship]]. Trooper held out against the waves of battle droids, which included [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|dwarf spider droids]], as they waited for the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] to arrive. After defeating the droid forces, the gunship arrived and picked up Trooper. Trooper manned the gunship's port [[Turret/Legends|turret]] as they made their way to the stronghold; destroying multiple [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]].<ref name="Blaster Game" />

The Republic's stronghold, now a battlefield, became too dangerous for the gunship to attempt a landing. The gunship landed in an area away from the battle and dropped off Trooper with a [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]]. Trooper embarked on the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] and made their way to rendezvous with Captain Rex. On the way to the rendezvous, Trooper encountered and fought off battle droids aboard STAPs, vulture droids, and a [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|hailfire droid]]. Upon meeting up with Rex and the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] he amassed, the group of clones boarded a transport bound for the Republic stronghold.<ref name="Blaster Game" />

===Defending the stronghold===
{{Quote|All clear General.|Trooper|audio=TrooperAllClear.mp3|<ref name="Blaster Game" />}}
[[File:CTBG-AAT.png|thumb|left|250px|On the way to the defense outpost, Trooper battles an AAT.]]
Aboard the transport, Trooper began laying down fire on the battle droids that were attacking the stronghold. The platoon fended off the enemy forces enough to successfully land at the stronghold; now taken over by the droid army. Trooper met up with Obi-Wan Kenobi who had just sent a demolition crew to blast open a door. Once open, Trooper and Kenobi entered the stronghold and made their way to the core of the base, fighting off droids in the process. At the core, they found the Jedi artifacts safe, however the base was not yet secure. Captain Rex sent Trooper to the stronghold's sniper position to defend against the threats outside while Rex and his troops secured the inside.<ref name="Blaster Game" />

Shortly after securing the base, Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived at the base. Trooper was tasked with escorting Skywalker to the main battlefield by taking the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] position on the escort [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. After arriving at the frontlines, Rex regrouped the Republic forces and prepared for an all out assault on the droid army. Rex gave Trooper one final mission, to return to the defense outpost and eliminate the Separatists' [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] on the way there. With those final orders, Trooper boarded a BARC speeder and headed to the outpost; encountering and destroying the AAT in the process and successfully completing the mission.<ref name="Blaster Game" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett, Trooper shared Fett's [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin<ref name="Skin" /> and height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="db" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Heads up Trooper, your gunship has arrived, and is ready to take you to the stronghold. With the generators fully operational now, we can make use of your heavy weapons training on the way to the Stronghold. Get on board and man the port turret.|Rex|<ref name="Blaster Game" />}}
Trooper was proficient at using different types of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Trooper also had [[Heavy weapon specialist|heavy weapons training]], which made them a capable gunner for ships.<ref name="Blaster Game" />

==Equipment==
[[File:CTBG-PlainTrooper.png|thumb|right|250px|Trooper in white, unmarked Phase I armor.]]
During battle, Trooper utilized a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] and [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]], as well as [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. Trooper wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]].<ref name="Blaster Game" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Clone Trooper Blaster Game}}
Trooper's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] would later be adorned with blue markings, and they would wear a [[Kama/Legends|kama]].<ref name="Blaster Game" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Trooper appeared in the ''[[Clone Trooper Blaster Game]]'' created by [[Tiger Electronics]] and developed by [[Santa Cruz Games]]. The game was released in [[2008]]. Each mission in the game has a medal the player can earn by completing a specific challenge. This article assumes the player has earned all ten mission medals, which results in Trooper receiving blue markings on their armor and a kama.<ref name="Blaster Game" />
